About Us

Sharing the beauty of Igbaras, one mountain at a time.

Who We Are

Mountains of Igbaras is a tourism information website created to introduce visitors to the natural beauty and outdoor destinations of Igbaras, Iloilo, Philippines.

Through this website, we aim to showcase mountain landscapes, outdoor activities, and useful information for people who want to discover the area.

Our Mission

Our mission is to promote responsible tourism, encourage appreciation of nature, and help visitors learn about the mountains and natural attractions of Igbaras.

Our Vision

We envision Igbaras as a destination where visitors can enjoy outdoor adventures while respecting the environment, local communities, and cultural heritage.

What We Value

🌿 Nature

Protect forests, wildlife, and mountain ecosystems.

⛰️ Adventure

Inspire people to explore the outdoors responsibly.

🤝 Community

Respect local traditions and support local livelihoods.
